Our Healthcare Range can incorporate a unique set of design requirements, including third-party
Q-Mark fire certification, enhanced durability, anti-bacterial protection, accessibility, acoustic
performance, access control and more.

Create a certified fire door specification tailored to the unique requirements of your project,
using compatible and tested elements, within minutes.

[Fire Door CPD Session]

# Book a Fire Door CPD Session

If you’re an architect, interior designer, specifier or main contractor and would like to learn more
about fire doors, why not arrange a fire door CPD with us?

[ Book Now ][68]

# Elegant & Timeless Artisan Panel Doors

Our bespoke Artisan doors grace some of the finest residences in the UK. Tailored to your interior
design scheme - you choose the style, material and finish.

[ Learn more ][69]

[Fire Doors for Schools]

# Severe-duty Fire Doors for Schools

Our Education Range Doors have been developed specifically for school, college and university
environments, and come with fully compatible, factory fitted ironmongery as standard.

[ Learn More ][70]

[AhmGuard Finger Protection for Fire Doors]

# Seamless & Integral Finger Protection

The durable metal pivot system and curved edge of our AhmGuard finger protection solution form an
integral part of the timber doorset, rather than being an add-on feature - as required by the DFE’s
output specification document (Nov 2020).

[ Learn More ][71]

[BIM Building Information Modelling for Fire Doors]

# BIM Models

Use our BIM service to create intelligent 3D models of your internal fire doorsets that
automatically update as you change the specifications of elements within them.

# Amptek AT A GLANCE

Amptek is a high technology company and a recognized world leader in the design and manufacture of
state-of-the-art nuclear instrumentation for the satellite, x-ray and gamma ray detection,

## Asian Pacific Mathematics Olympiad
* [About (current)][1]
* [Regulations ][2]
* [Timeline][3]
* [Countries][4]
* [Problems][5]
* [Results][6]

The Asian Pacific Mathematics Olympiad (APMO) is a mathematical competition for countries in the
Pacific-Rim Region.

The APMO is held annually. Each participating country has a representative in charge of organizing
the APMO locally. A central committee selects a paper with 5 questions to be solved in 4 hours,
sends marking schemes and determines award winners.

The APMO started in 1989. It has the following aims:
* Discovering, encouraging and challenging mathematically gifted high-school students.
* Fostering friendly international relations and cooperation between students and teachers
  throughout the region.
* Creating opportunities for the exchange of information on school syllabi and practice.
* Encouraging and supporting the mathematical involvement with Olympiad type activities in the
  participating countries and other countries of the region.

## svt becomes Saverto

The Saverto Group is headquartered in Germany and has established itself worldwide as a reliable
manufacturer and supplier of passive fire protection solutions. Saverto is the new international
umbrella brand of the svt Group of Companies, which has over 50 years’ experience in the industry.

Saverto comprises several independently managed product brands, including FLAMRO^{®}, KuhnOdice and
Pyroguard. This extensive portfolio offers the most comprehensive selection of cutting-edge fire
protection products for the construction and industrial sectors, as well as fire-resistant glazing.
Our customers benefit from a wide range of fire protection products, materials and systems, all of
which are backed by decades of unique, market-leading industry expertise.

## Our lead brands

Our lead brands form the heart of Saverto offer reliable preventive fire protection solutions to
ensure safety in case of fire:

[Wort- und Bildmarke: Rotes Logo von FLAMRO] [Wort- und Bildmarke: Rotes Logo von FLAMRO]

### Your expert in passive constructional fire protection

We have been developing and manufacturing high-performance fire protection solutions for preventive
constructional fire safety for over 40 years. Our certified penetration seals, cable coatings, air
vents, fire protection collars, etc. ensure facility safety worldwide in the event of a fire.

[ flamro.com ][10]
[Wort- und Bildmarke: Dunkelgrünes Logo von kuhn odice] [Wort- und Bildmarke: Weißes Logo von kuhn
odice]

### Your vital partner for fire safety

We are your comprehensive solution provider for passive fire protection. With our advanced fire
protection materials and systems – designed for the glazing and door industries, OEMs in industrial
applications, battery safety, as well as the transportation and mobility sectors—we excel as a
full-service partner supporting customers even with complex custom solutions.

[ kuhnodice.com ][11]
[Wort- und Bildmarke: Orange-schwarzes Logo von Pyroguard] [Wort- und Bildmarke: Orange-weißes Logo
von Pyroguard]

### Global expertise in fire safety glass

We provide the widest range of tested and certified fire safety glass solutions on the market
enabling architects, specifiers and installers to achieve their vision of safe and beautiful living
and working spaces. Even under extreme temperatures, our fire protection glazing provide reliable
protection – without compromise.

[ pyroguard.eu ][12]

Innovative, international, certified

## Comprehensive fire protection for three markets

As a global leader in fire protection, we provide tailored solutions for three key markets:
construction, industry, and fire-resistant glazing. Leveraging our extensive expertise and our
commitment to innovative technologies results in our certified fire protection solutions according
to international approvals, such as
* Construction: UL 1479/ASTM E814, UL 2079/ASTM E1966, FM 3971, EN 1366, IEC 60332-3-22
* Industry: EN 13501, EN 1634, EN 45545, SOLAS
* Fire-resistant glazing: EN 1363, EN 1634

Research meets practice

## Setting new standards in fire protection

Our Research and development departments form the backbone of innovation, quality, and product
safety. At our sites in Germany, France, and United Kingdom, our expert teams are dedicated to
creating new, sustainable solutions, securing necessary certifications, and ensuring the highest
product quality.

Building on this research, our technical departments develop practical and innovative fire
protection solutions tailored to real-world requirements. This results in powerful yet
easy-to-install products that meet the highest standards. We continuously expand our portfolio to
address even the most complex challenges. With state-of-the-art in-house testing facilities and
close collaboration with accredited laboratories, we guarantee top quality and comprehensively
manage the approval process for new products – from development through to market readiness.

### Global expertise in fire safety glass

We provide the widest range of tested and certified fire safety glass solutions on the market
enabling architects, specifiers and installers to achieve their vision of safe and beautiful living
and working spaces. Even under extreme temperatures, our fire protection glazing provide reliable
protection – without compromise.

[ pyroguard.eu ][12]

Innovative, international, certified

## Comprehensive fire protection for three markets

As a global leader in fire protection, we provide tailored solutions for three key markets:
construction, industry, and fire-resistant glazing. Leveraging our extensive expertise and our
commitment to innovative technologies results in our certified fire protection solutions according
to international approvals, such as
* Construction: UL 1479/ASTM E814, UL 2079/ASTM E1966, FM 3971, EN 1366, IEC 60332-3-22
* Industry: EN 13501, EN 1634, EN 45545, SOLAS
* Fire-resistant glazing: EN 1363, EN 1634

Research meets practice

## Setting new standards in fire protection

Our Research and development departments form the backbone of innovation, quality, and product
safety. At our sites in Germany, France, and United Kingdom, our expert teams are dedicated to
creating new, sustainable solutions, securing necessary certifications, and ensuring the highest
product quality.

Building on this research, our technical departments develop practical and innovative fire
protection solutions tailored to real-world requirements. This results in powerful yet
easy-to-install products that meet the highest standards. We continuously expand our portfolio to
address even the most complex challenges. With state-of-the-art in-house testing facilities and
close collaboration with accredited laboratories, we guarantee top quality and comprehensively
manage the approval process for new products – from development through to market readiness.

# Cognition operates Devin, the first autonomous software engineer.

We believe the purpose of technology is to expand human capacity — not by replacing meaningful work
but by working alongside people as an exponential collaborator, helping them think deeper and move
faster. We build tools for software creation because software shapes nearly every aspect of modern
life. Cognition helps engineers operate more like architects: strategizing, designing systems, and
focusing on problem solving, while agents handle the repetitive engineering work.

Devin plans, writes, tests, and ships production code on its own, working inside your codebase and
the tools your team already uses. Devin is deployed at some of the largest and most complex
institutions in the world.

# Cognition operates Devin, the first autonomous software engineer.

We believe the purpose of technology is to expand human capacity — not by replacing meaningful work
but by working alongside people as an exponential collaborator, helping them think deeper and move
faster. We build tools for software creation because software shapes nearly every aspect of modern
life. Cognition helps engineers operate more like architects: strategizing, designing systems, and
focusing on problem solving, while agents handle the repetitive engineering work.

Devin plans, writes, tests, and ships production code on its own, working inside your codebase and
the tools your team already uses. Devin is deployed at some of the largest and most complex
institutions in the world.

## What is the Real-Time Wildfire Map?

Our interactive wildfire map uses satellite data from NASA FIRMS (Fire Information for Resource
Management System) to display every active fire around the world. The satellites detect new fires
several times a day and the map refreshes automatically every 10 minutes, surfacing wildfires,
forest fires, agricultural burns, and other fire events detected by VIIRS satellites.

### Popular Wildfire Regions

**North America:** [United States][11], [California][12], [Canada][13], [Mexico][14], [Texas][15],
[Pacific Northwest][16], [Arizona][17], [Colorado][18], [Hawaii][19], [British Columbia][20],
[Alberta][21], [Quebec][22]

**Europe:** [France][23], [Spain][24], [Italy][25], [Greece][26], [Portugal][27]

**South America:** [Brazil][28], [Argentina][29], [Amazon Rainforest][30], [Patagonia][31],
[Chile][32], [Colombia][33], [Bolivia][34]

**Oceania:** [Australia][35], [New Zealand][36]

**Asia:** [Turkey][37], [Siberia][38], [Indonesia][39], [India][40], [Southeast Asia][41]

**Africa:** [Congo Basin][42], [South Africa][43], [Madagascar][44], [Sub-Saharan Africa][45]

[View all regions →][46]

### Global Wildfire Coverage

Monitor active wildfires across North America, South America, Europe, Asia, Africa, and Oceania.
Track fires in the United States, Canada, Brazil, Argentina, Chile, Spain, Australia, California,
and more. Our fire map provides comprehensive global coverage of all major wildfire zones.

### Wildfire Map Features
* **NASA FIRMS satellite data** - Official satellite fire detection system
* **Every active fire point tracked** - Comprehensive wildfire tracking
* **Map refreshes every 10 minutes** - New detections as satellites pass
* **Intensity filters** - Critical and medium fire classification
* **Temperature & confidence data** - Fire brightness and detection accuracy
* **EONET wildfire events** - Major wildfire incidents with details
* **Global fire coverage** - Worldwide wildfire monitoring

### How Does the Wildfire Map Work?

Our wildfire tracker uses data from NASA's VIIRS (Visible Infrared Imaging Radiometer Suite)
satellite instruments. These satellites detect thermal anomalies indicating active fires and provide
wildfire data updated multiple times a day to emergency managers, firefighters, and the public.

## About Designer Doorware's Capabilities

Designer Doorware designs and manufactures superior quality door furniture and architectural
hardware including [hinges][79], [door handles][80] and door knobs, [door pull handles][81],
[sliding door hardware][82], [door hardware accessories][83], [door closers][84], [locks,][85]
[cabinet door handles][86], and [bathroom accessories][87]. Our products offer timeless qualities to
suit a variety of architectural styles and budgets, with thousands of product options and
combinations to choose from.

If you are looking for something extra special, our [custom design service][88] can create hardware
to complement any commercial or residential project, no matter how unique your requirements. We
regularly work with Architects, Designers, Developers and Builders on award winning [projects][89]
of all sizes across Australia, Asia-Pacific and the USA. With know-how gained through many years of
specialised design experience, a well-established [international network][90] and best-of-breed
manufacturing capabilities, we can operate to short lead times and quickly deliver doorware and
accessories anywhere in the world.

Our new [Selector Tool][91] makes it easy to visualise, compare and [select architectural hardware
online][92]. You can review a wide range of products, find related products, get tailored
specification sheets, make them into a PDF book and request a quote for your specified products. We
also make doorware selection easier with [customer services][93] that incorporate interior [design
advice][94], [specifying][95], [scheduling][96] and more. [Contact][97] our friendly, highly
qualified team to help create that final complement to your project.

Projects
Our Projects
[
Mornington BESS (240MW / 480MWh)
Mornington BESS, located in Tyabb on the Mornington Peninsula, is a 240 MW / 480 MWh Battery Energy
Storage System developed by Valent Energy. It connects to the Tyabb Terminal Station through AusNet
Services infrastructure and will store renewable energy to power ≈ 40,000 homes. DIS Fire Systems
was engaged by ACLE to deliver the sitewide fire detection, alarm and warning system integration for
this landmark renewable-energy facility
][24]
[
Terang BESS
The Terang Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) is a 100 MW / 200 MWh project located at 70 Littles
Lane beside the Terang Terminal Station. Delivered by Canadian Solar and TEC-C for FRV, the project
includes 48 battery containers across 1.4 hectares. DIS Fire Systems was engaged to deliver the
complete fire protection scope — design, supply, installation, and commissioning — along with
documentation to support CFA and local-authority compliance
][25]
[
Bluegrass BESS
Bluegrass BESS forms part of the Blue Grass Solar Farm on the Warrego Highway near Chinchilla, QLD.
The project includes around 60 Narada battery energy storage containers providing renewable power to
the Western Downs region. DIS Fire Systems delivered the full commissioning scope for the fire
detection and hydrant network, developing ITPs, ITRs, and SAT documents for client handover.
][26]

Comprehensive Safety Solutions
Fire Protection Solutions Designed for Every Risk

### Battery Energy Storage Systems

As renewable energy expands, BESS fire protection in Australia is more important than ever. DIS Fire
designs tailored solutions to manage the risks of lithium-ion batteries, including thermal runaway
and toxic gas release. Our BESS projects span Sydney, Melbourne, and major energy hubs across the
country.

[Learn more][103]

### Kitchen Fire Suppression Systems

Protect your commercial kitchen in Australia with fast-acting fire suppression systems that stop
fires before they spread. DIS Fire provides kitchen fire protection in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane,
and nationwide, helping restaurants and hospitality venues minimize downtime, reduce damage, and
stay compliant with Australian fire safety standards.

[Learn more][104]

### Gas Suppression Systems

DIS Fire delivers gas fire suppression solutions across Australia for data centres, server rooms,
and critical facilities. Our systems extinguish fires rapidly without water damage, making them
ideal for Sydney businesses, Melbourne offices, and industrial sites nationwide that require clean
and reliable fire protection.

[Learn more][105]

### Water Mist Fire Protection

Keep sensitive equipment and enclosed spaces safe with water mist fire suppression in Australia. DIS
Fire’s advanced systems are trusted across healthcare, commercial, and government facilities in
Sydney, Brisbane, and Perth, providing powerful suppression while avoiding costly water damage.

[Learn more][106]

### Foam Fire Suppression

DIS Fire provides foam suppression systems in Australia for industrial sites, chemical processing
plants, and fuel storage facilities. Our solutions rapidly control flammable liquid fires, helping
businesses in Sydney, Perth, and mining regions reduce risks and protect critical infrastructure.

[Learn more][107]

### Fire Detection & Monitoring

Stay compliant with Australian fire safety regulations using DIS Fire’s detection and monitoring
systems. From room integrity testing in Sydney to linear heat detection across Melbourne and
Brisbane, we ensure your fire suppression systems are effective, reliable, and audit-ready.

Partner with the Experts

fire safety and performance.

### Battery Energy Storage Systems

As renewable energy expands, BESS fire protection in Australia is more important than ever. DIS Fire
designs tailored solutions to manage the risks of lithium-ion batteries, including thermal runaway
and toxic gas release. Our BESS projects span Sydney, Melbourne, and major energy hubs across the
country.

### Kitchen Fire Suppression Systems

Protect your commercial kitchen in Australia with fast-acting fire suppression systems that stop
fires before they spread. DIS Fire provides kitchen fire protection in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane,
and nationwide, helping restaurants and hospitality venues minimize downtime, reduce damage, and
stay compliant with Australian fire safety standards.

[Learn more][104]

### Gas Suppression Systems

DIS Fire delivers gas fire suppression solutions across Australia for data centres, server rooms,
and critical facilities. Our systems extinguish fires rapidly without water damage, making them
ideal for Sydney businesses, Melbourne offices, and industrial sites nationwide that require clean
and reliable fire protection.

[Learn more][105]

### Water Mist Fire Protection

Keep sensitive equipment and enclosed spaces safe with water mist fire suppression in Australia. DIS
Fire’s advanced systems are trusted across healthcare, commercial, and government facilities in
Sydney, Brisbane, and Perth, providing powerful suppression while avoiding costly water damage.

[Learn more][106]

### Foam Fire Suppression

DIS Fire provides foam suppression systems in Australia for industrial sites, chemical processing
plants, and fuel storage facilities. Our solutions rapidly control flammable liquid fires, helping
businesses in Sydney, Perth, and mining regions reduce risks and protect critical infrastructure.

[Learn more][107]

### Fire Detection & Monitoring

Stay compliant with Australian fire safety regulations using DIS Fire’s detection and monitoring
systems. From room integrity testing in Sydney to linear heat detection across Melbourne and
Brisbane, we ensure your fire suppression systems are effective, reliable, and audit-ready.

# Welcome to Dräger in India

**Turning technology into “Technology for Life”**

Dräger manufactures medical and safety technology products. In so doing, we protect, support, and
save people's lives around the world in hospitals, with fire departments, emergency services,
authorities, and in mining as well as industry. Founded in Lübeck in 1889, Dräger has grown into a
worldwide, listed enterprise in its fifth generation as a family-run business. Dräger has more than
16,000 employees worldwide and is present in over 190 countries around the globe. In 2023, the
company generated net sales of around EUR 3.4 billion.

Dräger technology is used all over the world. We operate in around 50 countries with our own sales
and service companies directly on location where our customers are.

[male-doctor-3-2-D-30493-2017]

Improving critical care is what drives us. Learn how our solutions can help you protect, support and
save lives – across departments and across your hospital.

[Learn more][84]

Dräger is a globally recognised name in the field of safety technology. No matter your industry, our
focus is to keep you safe on the job.

[Learn more][85]
[contact-us_safety-3-2]

#### Contact

Get in touch with Dräger. We are happy to help.

[Contact Us][86]

restriction to movement: The Dräger X-plore 8300 is the smallest and lightest PAPR device in its

As trusted partners, we are dedicated to ensuring that no matter the complexity of the task, you

Suraksha Parmo Dharma, a Sanskrit maxim, it means safety is the highest duty. In an era where
workplace hazards, industrial accidents and emergency response risks persist.

# Welcome to Dräger in India

**Turning technology into “Technology for Life”**

Dräger manufactures medical and safety technology products. In so doing, we protect, support, and
save people's lives around the world in hospitals, with fire departments, emergency services,
authorities, and in mining as well as industry. Founded in Lübeck in 1889, Dräger has grown into a
worldwide, listed enterprise in its fifth generation as a family-run business. Dräger has more than
16,000 employees worldwide and is present in over 190 countries around the globe. In 2023, the
company generated net sales of around EUR 3.4 billion.

Dräger technology is used all over the world. We operate in around 50 countries with our own sales
and service companies directly on location where our customers are.

[male-doctor-3-2-D-30493-2017]

#### Hospital

Improving critical care is what drives us. Learn how our solutions can help you protect, support and
save lives – across departments and across your hospital.

[Learn more][84]
[Dräger puts safety first with protective equipment for all industrial purposes]

#### Safety

Dräger is a globally recognised name in the field of safety technology. No matter your industry, our
focus is to keep you safe on the job.

[Learn more][85]

#### Dräger X-node

Dräger X-node is a wireless IoT solution for process monitoring and analysis. The system solution
converts reliable measurement data - gas concentration, temperature, humidity and pressure - from
the X-node device into valuable information that you can access, analyse, visualise, monitor and
store online via the X-node Hub.

[Learn more][90]
[X-plore-8300-carpentry-3-2]

#### Dräger X-plore 8300

Reliable respiratory protection against harmful particles with no noticeable breathing resistance or
restriction to movement: The Dräger X-plore 8300 is the smallest and lightest PAPR device in its
class, offering maximum protection and comfort.

[Learn more][91]
[Main-Suraksha-Parmo-Dharma-v2-3-2]

#### Suraksha Parmo Dharma

As trusted partners, we are dedicated to ensuring that no matter the complexity of the task, you
have Dräger's unwavering support. 

Suraksha Parmo Dharma, a Sanskrit maxim, it means safety is the highest duty. In an era where
workplace hazards, industrial accidents and emergency response risks persist.

[Learn more][92]

Dräger Safety India proudly announces its successful CSR initiative with PCVC, supporting survivors
of domestic and interpersonal violence, highlighting our commitment to protecting and saving lives.

## Leading the way in compliance solutions

Get compliance support from the only life safety company under the guidance of former Joint
Commission surveyors. Your facility deserves the attention of our specially trained and accredited
nationwide team of inspectors and technicians. We’re the experts in compliance. So you don’t have to
be.

### Flexibility

We have inspectors that are certified through the International Fire Door Inspector Association to
provide fire door inspection services in all 50 states. We even offer a certified remote door
inspection option for entities unable to accommodate an inspector on-site or with limited doors.
That makes us one of the largest compliance networks in the nation, skilled and trained to support
every kind of healthcare facility.

### Experience

We’re one of the largest full-service providers for fire-rated doors within the United States,
serving thousands of customers nationwide. As the national leader in compliance services for passive
fire protection systems, we only provide services completed by our team of employees. And always
with the highest standards of efficiency and consistency.

### Reporting

Our innovative and comprehensive reports give you a complete picture, making asset tracking concise
and simple. Our reports don’t just meet the industry standards set by Centers for Medicare &
Medicaid (CMS), The Joint Commission (TJC), Det Norske Veritas group (DNV), and Healthcare
Facilities Accreditation Program (HVAP), we exceed the expectations. We provide you with fully
documented digital and written summaries that include preventative maintenance programs and a
pathway to full NFPA compliance.

### Value

We understand the challenges you face because we’ve been there. Our company is under the guidance of
former Joint Commission and DMV surveyors which makes our deep understanding of compliance unrivaled
in the industry. That’s why we’re able to offer unparalleled solutions to even the most complicated
problems, keeping your facility compliant no matter the obstacles or budget restrictions.

## The partner you need for life safety solutions

## ** is Compliance managing you?**

We are a nationwide fire and professional services company, specializes in helping our customers
Navigate and maintain the complex world of safety and compliance.

## Reporting & Documentation

We provide inspection-ready life safety reporting for all service lines. REMEDI8®'s goals are
simple. First, to ensure you pass your fire and life safety code inspections, and secondly, to
ensure your facility remains safe and fully compliant with all building and fire codes.

## Long-Term Compliance Programs

Maintaining your life safety system is crucial to protecting people in your facility. It can be
challenging to stay on top of the fire code, let alone to maintain the many parts of a functional
system. We’ll evaluate your compliance status quo, identify gaps in your provision, and provide you
with a customized plan and schedule to rectify any issues.

## Leading the way in compliance solutions

Get compliance support from the only life safety company under the guidance of former Joint
Commission surveyors. Your facility deserves the attention of our specially trained and accredited
nationwide team of inspectors and technicians. We’re the experts in compliance. So you don’t have to
be.

### Flexibility

We have inspectors that are certified through the International Fire Door Inspector Association to
provide fire door inspection services in all 50 states. We even offer a certified remote door
inspection option for entities unable to accommodate an inspector on-site or with limited doors.
That makes us one of the largest compliance networks in the nation, skilled and trained to support
every kind of healthcare facility.

### Experience

We’re one of the largest full-service providers for fire-rated doors within the United States,
serving thousands of customers nationwide. As the national leader in compliance services for passive
fire protection systems, we only provide services completed by our team of employees. And always
with the highest standards of efficiency and consistency.

### Reporting

Our innovative and comprehensive reports give you a complete picture, making asset tracking concise
and simple. Our reports don’t just meet the industry standards set by Centers for Medicare &
Medicaid (CMS), The Joint Commission (TJC), Det Norske Veritas group (DNV), and Healthcare
Facilities Accreditation Program (HVAP), we exceed the expectations. We provide you with fully
documented digital and written summaries that include preventative maintenance programs and a
pathway to full NFPA compliance.

### Value

We understand the challenges you face because we’ve been there. Our company is under the guidance of
former Joint Commission and DMV surveyors which makes our deep understanding of compliance unrivaled
in the industry. That’s why we’re able to offer unparalleled solutions to even the most complicated
problems, keeping your facility compliant no matter the obstacles or budget restrictions.

We provide inspection-ready life safety reporting for all service lines. REMEDI8®'s goals are
simple. First, to ensure you pass your fire and life safety code inspections, and secondly, to

Maintaining your life safety system is crucial to protecting people in your facility. It can be

system. We’ll evaluate your compliance status quo, identify gaps in your provision, and provide you
with a customized plan and schedule to rectify any issues.

## About the Wildfire Smoke Layer (Beta)

This layer visualizes surface concentrations of PM2.5 (fine particulate matter with a diameter of
2.5 micrometers or less) originating from wildfires. PM2.5 is a key air pollutant that can
significantly impact health and visibility.

#### Key Features:
* **Data Source:** Regional Deterministic Air Quality Analysis (RDAQA) system, Environment and
  Climate Change Canada.
* **Update Frequency:** Updated hourly, providing near real-time smoke information.
* **Resolution:** Data is processed at approximately 1km spatial resolution using bicubic resampling
  for smoother visualization.
* **Coverage:** Currently covers North America.
* **Status:** This is a BETA layer. Accuracy and availability may vary.

#### Coming Soon:
* Integration of global smoke data sources.
* Incorporation of PurpleAir sensor data for localized PM2.5 readings.
* Animated 72-hour smoke forecast.

This layer is intended for informational purposes to understand potential smoke impacts from
wildfires. Always consult official air quality advisories from your local health and environmental
agencies.

## About FireMap.live

×

Firemap.live is a comprehensive global wildfire tracking platform that integrates satellite data and
authoritative fire information from agencies across the world. It is powered by FireDB, which
enhances the data from NASA's Fire Information for Resource Management System (FIRMS) with
authoritative fire points sourced from agencies in the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Australia. This
combination allows Firemap.live to provide real-time, standardized global fire statuses.

The platform delivers detailed insights through real-time fire perimeters, heat maps, and fire
status updates. By combining early detection data from NASA FIRMS with local fire authorities,
Firemap.live offers one of the most reliable tools for wildfire monitoring and response. It is
particularly valuable for emergency responders, researchers, and anyone needing to stay updated on
global fire events.

**Disclaimer:** FireMap.live provides wildfire data for informational purposes only. Although we
strive for accuracy, this data should not be relied upon for critical safety decisions. Always
consult your local authorities or official emergency management agencies for the most accurate and
timely information. FireMap.live is not legally responsible or liable for any actions taken based
upon this data.

See [disasterdb.com/firedb][1] for more details.

FireMap may not be loading correctly. This can happen after an update.
Try **clearing your browser cache** or doing a hard refresh:

## About the Wildfire Smoke Layer (Beta)

This layer visualizes surface concentrations of PM2.5 (fine particulate matter with a diameter of
2.5 micrometers or less) originating from wildfires. PM2.5 is a key air pollutant that can
significantly impact health and visibility.

#### Key Features:
* **Data Source:** Regional Deterministic Air Quality Analysis (RDAQA) system, Environment and
  Climate Change Canada.
* **Update Frequency:** Updated hourly, providing near real-time smoke information.
* **Resolution:** Data is processed at approximately 1km spatial resolution using bicubic resampling
  for smoother visualization.
* **Coverage:** Currently covers North America.
* **Status:** This is a BETA layer. Accuracy and availability may vary.

#### Coming Soon:
* Integration of global smoke data sources.
* Incorporation of PurpleAir sensor data for localized PM2.5 readings.
* Animated 72-hour smoke forecast.

This layer is intended for informational purposes to understand potential smoke impacts from
wildfires. Always consult official air quality advisories from your local health and environmental
agencies.

## About FireMap.live

×

Firemap.live is a comprehensive global wildfire tracking platform that integrates satellite data and
authoritative fire information from agencies across the world. It is powered by FireDB, which
enhances the data from NASA's Fire Information for Resource Management System (FIRMS) with
authoritative fire points sourced from agencies in the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Australia. This
combination allows Firemap.live to provide real-time, standardized global fire statuses.

The platform delivers detailed insights through real-time fire perimeters, heat maps, and fire
status updates. By combining early detection data from NASA FIRMS with local fire authorities,
Firemap.live offers one of the most reliable tools for wildfire monitoring and response. It is
particularly valuable for emergency responders, researchers, and anyone needing to stay updated on
global fire events.

**Disclaimer:** FireMap.live provides wildfire data for informational purposes only. Although we
strive for accuracy, this data should not be relied upon for critical safety decisions. Always
consult your local authorities or official emergency management agencies for the most accurate and
timely information. FireMap.live is not legally responsible or liable for any actions taken based
upon this data.

See [disasterdb.com/firedb][1] for more details.

## FIRE. BLAST. STORM

### Roller Shutters • Industrial Doors

[Explore Our Products][33]

#### About Us

Gliderol Doors is an Integrated Solutions Specialists – we design, manufacture, install and service
protective roller shutters and industrial door systems for commercial, industrial, and
infrastructure applications across Singapore and Southeast Asia. With over 40 years of engineering
expertise and dedicated in-house R&D, we specialise in **life-safety and asset-protection
solutions** certified to international standards (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001).

Our Product Range:

[icon roller shutter]

##### Protective Shutters

Fire-Rated, Blast-Mitigating, and Storm-Resistant systems engineered to safeguard people and
property

[icon roller shutter]

##### Industrial & Commercial Doors

High-speed doors, sectional doors, hangar doors, and roller shutters for warehouses, factories, and
logistics facilities

[icon roller shutter]

##### Specialty Door Systems

Accordion fire doors (Won-Door) and large-scale industrial doors (Butzbach) through our global
partnerships

From design and fabrication to installation and ongoing maintenance, we deliver complete door
solutions backed by responsive 24/7 service support.

[Read more ][34]
[earth illustration]

# Features

**Insulated Fire Shutter**
* Certified to BS EN and local standards
* Withstand up to 4 hours of fire integrity
* Withstand up to 4 hours of fire insulation
* Keep people safe and minimize property damage
* Tested by leading fire labs, engineered for safety and reliability.

**Blast Mitigating Shutter**
* Tested at ABS Consulting, world-class shock tube facility, USA
* October 2022: first-ever blast mitigating roller shutter tested
* Limits damage under blast loads, enhancing safety and protection
* Withstands peak pressure up to 75 kPa
* Withstands peak impulse up to 1050 kPa-ms

# Product Highlights

We manufacture and supply an extensive range of commercial and industrial doors and shutter
solutions for every industry, which can be tailored to our customers’ specific needs and
requirements.

### Roller Shutters • Industrial Doors

#### About Us

Gliderol Doors is an Integrated Solutions Specialists – we design, manufacture, install and service
protective roller shutters and industrial door systems for commercial, industrial, and
infrastructure applications across Singapore and Southeast Asia. With over 40 years of engineering
expertise and dedicated in-house R&D, we specialise in **life-safety and asset-protection
solutions** certified to international standards (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001).

Our Product Range:

[icon roller shutter]

##### Protective Shutters

Fire-Rated, Blast-Mitigating, and Storm-Resistant systems engineered to safeguard people and
property

[icon roller shutter]

##### Industrial & Commercial Doors

High-speed doors, sectional doors, hangar doors, and roller shutters for warehouses, factories, and
logistics facilities

[icon roller shutter]

##### Specialty Door Systems

Accordion fire doors (Won-Door) and large-scale industrial doors (Butzbach) through our global
partnerships

From design and fabrication to installation and ongoing maintenance, we deliver complete door
solutions backed by responsive 24/7 service support.

[Read more ][34]
[earth illustration]

# Features

**Insulated Fire Shutter**
* Certified to BS EN and local standards
* Withstand up to 4 hours of fire integrity
* Withstand up to 4 hours of fire insulation
* Keep people safe and minimize property damage
* Tested by leading fire labs, engineered for safety and reliability.

**Blast Mitigating Shutter**
* Tested at ABS Consulting, world-class shock tube facility, USA
* October 2022: first-ever blast mitigating roller shutter tested
* Limits damage under blast loads, enhancing safety and protection
* Withstands peak pressure up to 75 kPa
* Withstands peak impulse up to 1050 kPa-ms

# Product Highlights

We manufacture and supply an extensive range of commercial and industrial doors and shutter
solutions for every industry, which can be tailored to our customers’ specific needs and
requirements.

## [Case Study | McNeese State University][215]

Kinetics Noise Control provided an acoustic solution that enhanced both the experience and
functionality of what ultimately became a defining architectural element of the Student Union.
[Kinetics’ kleen® absorptive panels][216] were incorporated throughout the main corridor, referred
to as “The Spine,” to help control reverberation and improve acoustic comfort within the expansive
open space.

[Learn More][217]

## DISCOVER

**[Plenum Fire Rated Barriers | PR-KNM][218]**

Kinetics Noise Control is excited to introduce PR-KNM, a plenum-rated mass-loaded vinyl barrier
designed to provide effective sound blocking while meeting strict smoke performance criteria for
return air plenums and ceiling cavities. This allows it to be used in applications where other MLV
barriers cannot.

**[Acoustic Louver Type KCDC][219]**

KCDC Acoustic Louver was engineered specifically for the demands of data centers. Designed to
deliver performance and practicality, KCDC achieves 50% open area while maintaining no sight line
and low pressure drop.

**[Lightweight Noise Barrier Walls | NOISEBLOCK PW275][220]**

NOISEBLOCK PW275 is a lightweight noise barrier wall, panel system engineered for acoustic and
structural performance. Manufactured with durable, extruded rigid PVC, our systems are designed to
withstand harsh conditions, but lightweight and versatile for rooftops, and easy installation.

**[Econetic Core Acoustical Panels][221]**

Utilizing a natural formaldehyde-free binder, Econetic Core Panels are compliant as an adhered and
fully wrapped finished product under the rigorous CDPH 01350 VOC testing standard. Specifying
Econetic Core panels assures your project will have a comfortable acoustic environment and healthy
indoor air quality.

**[LifeSPACE | Sustainable Kinetics Products][222]**

Intelligently sourced, sustainable products. Designed to enhance the well-being of occupied spaces
through performance and raw materials.

## **[APPLICATION RENDERINGS][223]**

The diverse product offerings from Kinetics Noise Control solve noise problems across industries and
markets. Explore our product applications galleries meant to showcase the impact of our acoustical
solutions in real-world settings.

**COMPANY OVERVIEW**
Kinetics Noise Control, Inc. was established in 1958 as industrial consultants focused on
controlling sound and vibration. Kinetics now produces the industry’s largest selection of products
and solutions that control airborne noise, isolate structure-borne vibration, enhance room
acoustics, create quiet spaces, and restrain non-structural building systems.

## [Case Study | McNeese State University][215]

Kinetics Noise Control provided an acoustic solution that enhanced both the experience and
functionality of what ultimately became a defining architectural element of the Student Union.
[Kinetics’ kleen® absorptive panels][216] were incorporated throughout the main corridor, referred
to as “The Spine,” to help control reverberation and improve acoustic comfort within the expansive
open space.

[Learn More][217]

## DISCOVER

**[Plenum Fire Rated Barriers | PR-KNM][218]**

Kinetics Noise Control is excited to introduce PR-KNM, a plenum-rated mass-loaded vinyl barrier
designed to provide effective sound blocking while meeting strict smoke performance criteria for
return air plenums and ceiling cavities. This allows it to be used in applications where other MLV
barriers cannot.

**[Acoustic Louver Type KCDC][219]**

KCDC Acoustic Louver was engineered specifically for the demands of data centers. Designed to
deliver performance and practicality, KCDC achieves 50% open area while maintaining no sight line
and low pressure drop.

**[Lightweight Noise Barrier Walls | NOISEBLOCK PW275][220]**

NOISEBLOCK PW275 is a lightweight noise barrier wall, panel system engineered for acoustic and
structural performance. Manufactured with durable, extruded rigid PVC, our systems are designed to
withstand harsh conditions, but lightweight and versatile for rooftops, and easy installation.

**[Econetic Core Acoustical Panels][221]**

Utilizing a natural formaldehyde-free binder, Econetic Core Panels are compliant as an adhered and
fully wrapped finished product under the rigorous CDPH 01350 VOC testing standard. Specifying
Econetic Core panels assures your project will have a comfortable acoustic environment and healthy
indoor air quality.

**[LifeSPACE | Sustainable Kinetics Products][222]**

Intelligently sourced, sustainable products. Designed to enhance the well-being of occupied spaces
through performance and raw materials.

## **[APPLICATION RENDERINGS][223]**

The diverse product offerings from Kinetics Noise Control solve noise problems across industries and
markets. Explore our product applications galleries meant to showcase the impact of our acoustical
solutions in real-world settings.

**COMPANY OVERVIEW**
Kinetics Noise Control, Inc. was established in 1958 as industrial consultants focused on
controlling sound and vibration. Kinetics now produces the industry’s largest selection of products
and solutions that control airborne noise, isolate structure-borne vibration, enhance room
acoustics, create quiet spaces, and restrain non-structural building systems.

# Doors That
# Do More^{™}

From curb appeal to cozy interiors, our doors bring comfort, beauty and connection to every space in
the home.

## Doors designed to make life and living better

solutions

At Masonite, we create Doors That Do More™ for the people who pass through them every day. We
believe doors should connect you with the people and things you care about most — and make life
easier, safer and more beautiful, too.

[

### Doors that reduce noise

Keep sound where it belongs—in or out of a room—with sound-dampening doors.

Learn more ][40]
[
[Modern entry way with a blue exterior front door with three panels and silver handle the house has
brown wood paneling wall on one side and a plain white wall with a long window and trees]

### Doors that enhance safety

Feel safer and more secure with integrated features like multipoint locks or fire- and impact-rated
doors.

Learn more ][41]
[
[A young girl walking through gray double front doors, each with 3/4 lite glass pane]

### Doors that increase light

Bring natural light into your home with doors that have more visible glass area.

Learn more ][42]
[

### Doors that conserve energy

Stay comfortable inside, whatever the weather is outside, with an exterior door system that provides
better protection from the elements.

][43]
[

### Doors that elevate style

Complement your home’s design with our curated collection of doors for the whole home.

][44]

[**AS 1530.4** / AS 1905.1][10] [**BS 476** / EN 1364][11] [**UL 9** / ASTM E119][12] [**EN 1363** /

fire-resistant glass, doors, and framing systems, backed by accredited test evidence. Ready for

## What is PyroSpec Glass?

**PyroSpec is a factory-direct fire-rated glass manufacturer** — not a trading intermediary.
Operating from a 60,000 m² ISO 9001:2015 facility in Guangdong, China, we produce **AS 1530.4, BS
476, UL 9, EN 1363, and MS 1073 certified fire glass systems** with Fire Resistance Levels from 30
to 180 minutes.

**Key facts:** Since 2003, we have delivered 500+ projects with NATA/UKAS-accredited test evidence
across 40+ countries. Every shipment includes complete compliance documentation — test reports, CAD
details, and certifier-ready paperwork — so approving authorities can verify compliance without
chasing documents.

**Who this is for:** Architects writing specifications, certifiers reviewing evidence, contractors
managing programme risk, and distributors seeking factory-direct supply. PyroSpec is the factory —
same certifications, same quality, supply-chain direct.

**Authoritative references:** [NCC 2025 (ABCB)][17] · [SIRIM MS 1073][18] · [AGWA][19] · [NATA][20]
· [Test Reports][21]
Last reviewed: June 28, 2026 — Aligned with NCC 2025 · AS 1530.4:2014 · ISO 9001:2015

## How to Select Fire-Rated Glass by Testing Standard

Every building code jurisdiction requires a specific fire testing standard. We help specifiers match
the right system to the right standard — with full test documentation ready for certifier review.
See [NCC 2025 (ABCB)][22] for current Australian requirements.

[
🇦🇺

Australian Standards: AS1530.4 / AS1905.1 / NCC 2025 Section C

AU Compliance Guide → ][23] [
🇬🇧

British Standards: BS 476 / EN 1364 / UK Building Regs Approved Doc B

UK Compliance Guide → ][24] [
🇺🇸

### What UL Rating Do I Need for IBC?

American Standards: UL 9 / ASTM E119 / NFPA 252

US Compliance Guide → ][25] [
🇪🇺

### How Does EN 1364 Compare to AS 1530.4?

European Standards: EN 1363 / EN 1364 / CE Marking

EU Compliance Guide → ][26] [
🇺🇾

### What Does Bomba Require Under MS 1073?

Malaysian Standards: SIRIM MS 1073 / Bomba / CIDB

Malaysia Compliance Guide → ][27]

## How to Choose the Right Fire-Rated Glass System

Selecting the correct system depends on your Fire Resistance Level (integrity only, or integrity +
insulation), standard, and application. Below are the four core system types.

Fire-Rated Glass Fire Door Systems Partition Systems Curtain Wall
[E60 borosilicate monolithic fire-rated glass for internal partitions and fire doors]
Integrity Only

### What Is the Difference Between E30 and E60 Fire Glass?

Integrity-only borosilicate fire glass for internal partitions and fire doors. Certified for flame
and smoke containment.

AS1530.4 BS476-22 30-120min
[EI60 insulated fire-rated glass with integrity and insulation for hospital corridors and atriums]
Integrity + Insulation

### When Do I Need EI60 Instead of E60 Fire Glass?

Composite fire glass with full thermal insulation. Required for hospital corridors, atriums, and
escape routes where radiant heat control is mandatory.

AS1530.4 EN 1363 EI30-EI120
[Fire door vision panel with tested fire-rated glass and intumescent seals]
Fire Door Systems

### What Size Vision Panel Is Certified for Fire Doors?

Tested vision panel assemblies for steel and timber fire doors. Supplied with certifier-ready
hardware compatibility documentation.

AS1905.1 EN1634-1 UL10B
[Fire-rated partition system with steel framing for commercial office interiors]
Partition Systems

### How Are Fire-Rated Partitions Tested as Complete Systems?

Full assemblies: glass + framing + seals tested together. Designed for commercial fit-outs and
office fire compartments.

BS476 AS1530.4 Custom FRL

## How Do Fire Glazing Requirements Change by Building Type?

Fire safety provisions in the [NCC 2025 (ABCB)][28] vary by building classification. Below are the
FRL and boundary requirements for each sector.

🏥

### Healthcare (NCC Class 9a)

Hospitals, clinics and aged care facilities require stringent EI-rated fire separation between
wards, corridors and fire-isolated exits. Patient evacuation constraints drive higher FRL
requirements.

AS1530.4 / BS476 Part 22
🏫

### Education (NCC Class 9b)

Schools and universities need classroom-to-corridor fire protection, often with visibility and
acoustic requirements for supervision and learning environments.

NCC 2025 / BCA
🏢

### Commercial & Office (NCC Class 5)

Tenancy separations, atrium boundaries and egress corridors demand reliable EI-rated glazing and
framing systems that meet NCC 2025 Section C Deemed-to-Satisfy provisions.

EI60 / EI90 / Custom FRL
🏨

### Hospitality (NCC Class 3/6)

Hotels and mixed-use developments require discreet fire-rated glazing that meets both aesthetic
expectations and FRL codes for sleeping areas and public assembly spaces.

AS1530.4 / EN1364
🏛

### Government & Defence

Public buildings, transit stations and defence facilities demand fully documented, independently
tested fire systems with complete evidence trails for security-sensitive approvals.

Full Evidence Trail
🚁

### Transport Infrastructure

Airports, rail stations and tunnels require smoke barrier and fire compartment glazing with rapid
installation cycles and minimal operational disruption during construction.

Smoke Barrier / E120

We combine factory-direct manufacturing with specification-level technical support, helping you move
from design intent to certifier sign-off with confidence.

## How Do Fire Glazing Requirements Change by Building Type?

Fire safety provisions in the [NCC 2025 (ABCB)][28] vary by building classification. Below are the
FRL and boundary requirements for each sector.

🏥

### Healthcare (NCC Class 9a)

Hospitals, clinics and aged care facilities require stringent EI-rated fire separation between
wards, corridors and fire-isolated exits. Patient evacuation constraints drive higher FRL
requirements.

AS1530.4 / BS476 Part 22
🏫

### Education (NCC Class 9b)

Schools and universities need classroom-to-corridor fire protection, often with visibility and
acoustic requirements for supervision and learning environments.

NCC 2025 / BCA
🏢

### Commercial & Office (NCC Class 5)

Tenancy separations, atrium boundaries and egress corridors demand reliable EI-rated glazing and
framing systems that meet NCC 2025 Section C Deemed-to-Satisfy provisions.

EI60 / EI90 / Custom FRL
🏨

### Hospitality (NCC Class 3/6)

Hotels and mixed-use developments require discreet fire-rated glazing that meets both aesthetic
expectations and FRL codes for sleeping areas and public assembly spaces.

AS1530.4 / EN1364
🏛

### Government & Defence

Public buildings, transit stations and defence facilities demand fully documented, independently
tested fire systems with complete evidence trails for security-sensitive approvals.

Full Evidence Trail
🚁

### Transport Infrastructure

Airports, rail stations and tunnels require smoke barrier and fire compartment glazing with rapid
installation cycles and minimal operational disruption during construction.

Smoke Barrier / E120
